logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for the WO-04 assurance handover (round 4, packaging-robot cell selection). Scene: a compact editorial cutaway of a packaging robot cell on an acceptance test stand, with a kilowatt-hour meter reading a low value for the selected package, a clipboard showing a two-row gate checklist (quality at least 80; defects at most 5), and two engineers completing a handover baton over a small energy-ladder chart of four bars labeled P1, P3, P2, P4 rising left to right. Style: clean flat vector, navy and green palette on white, no photorealism, no logos. The image must serve the report's analysis of lowest-energy selection and handover assurance; it contains no hidden symbols or codes.
